Understanding C2PA

What it is, how it works, why platforms read it.

01

What is C2PA?

An open standard from the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity that binds a verifiable history (the provenance) to a digital file. Unlike EXIF — easy to edit — C2PA uses cryptographic signatures embedded as JUMBF blocks.

02

How it works

When a C2PA-enabled camera or AI tool produces an image, it generates a signed Assertion Manifest with claims about the creator, edits, and timestamps. The block is hashed and signed with public-key crypto. If a single pixel changes after the fact, validation breaks.

03

Why platforms read it

Meta, Pinterest, and others parse C2PA on upload to auto-tag AI content or limit distribution. The cleaner rebuilds the image from raw pixels, so the signed chain isn't carried into the export.

Metadata audit

Drop an image to see what metadata it carries before cleaning.

Strips EXIF, GPS, IPTC, XMP, and C2PA Content Credentials by redrawing your photos pixel-by-pixel. Nothing leaves your device.

How it works

Three steps. No servers involved.

01

Drop your image

JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, or HEIC from your phone. Up to 25 MB free, 100 MB on Pro.

02

We redraw the pixels

An invisible HTML5 canvas renders raw RGB data. EXIF, GPS, XMP, JUMBF, C2PA - all of it lives in the file structure, not the pixels.

03

Download the clean file

A fresh export at 95% quality. Bit-for-bit free of the original metadata.

Features

Everything you can strip from a photo.

Modern image files carry far more than the picture itself. ScrubAI removes the parts you didn't put there yourself.

100% client-side

Image bytes never go over the network. The canvas pipeline runs entirely inside your browser sandbox.

Pixel redraw, not tag deletion

Most tools strip EXIF headers and stop. ScrubAI rebuilds the file from raw pixels, so JUMBF blocks and signed C2PA chains are gone too.

C2PA & 'Made with AI' tags

Cryptographically signed Content Credentials embedded by Adobe, OpenAI, and Midjourney are removed at the source.

Batch up to 50 images

Pro users drag in queues, run them through the cleaner in one pass, and download a single ZIP. Built for workflows.

Live metadata inspector

See exactly what's in your file before stripping it. EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and C2PA structures surfaced in plain language.

Zero telemetry on content

We track UI events to improve the product. We never log image bytes, filenames, or extracted metadata. Period.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

When you load an image, ScrubAI draws its raw pixels onto an invisible HTML5 canvas, then re-exports those pixels as a brand-new file. Because the export is built from scratch, it carries none of the original EXIF, XMP, IPTC, or cryptographically signed C2PA credentials.

No. ScrubAI processes images in your browser's sandbox at a 95% quality threshold, preserving sharp edges and pixel-perfect detail. You get a clean export, not a degraded one.

Yes. Platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and Pinterest read image headers for software signatures, AI generation markers, and signed C2PA / JUMBF credentials. Pixel redraw rebuilds the file from scratch, so those embedded markers don't make it into the export.

Never. ScrubAI is a 100% local tool. Your files don't leave your device. All canvas work, EXIF parsing, and ZIP packaging runs inside your browser sandbox.

Yes. Lifetime Pro is a one-time $24.99 payment via PayPal. No monthly fees, no auto-renew. It unlocks batch processing up to 50 files, ZIP exports, and priority support - for life.

Need to clean a whole batch?

Lifetime Pro unlocks 50 images per batch, unlimited daily cleans, and ZIP exports. One-time $24.99. No subscription.
